reviews.title: Nice Motherboard
reviews.comment: Working great so far, but only had for couple of weeks. Looks great too.
reviews.author: Larry P

reviews.title: Great board for a great price
reviews.comment: A decent board that I got for 116$ new because of discounts and an ongoing sale. Works just fine and even had underglow. However I did knock one star off because the motherboard box itself wasn’t really taped so it could have easily opened during shipping. It was all fine though so nothing serious really. Just wish they at least spared an inch of tape
reviews.author: Shamil Burkhanov
